records.upstreamTitle: Add particle effect for session title updates
records.rationale: Voktty shows generated titles and linked work items in live session history, animates sidebar title updates with ParticleText, and flushes received Harness events before submitting the next message.

records.upstreamTitle: Add insertion animation for new sidebar sessions
records.rationale: New session rows slide into Voktty's sidebar once after the list is established; restored and reordered rows do not replay the animation, and reduced-motion preferences are respected.

records.upstreamTitle: Support live remaining-usage display in provider chip
records.rationale: The Voktty usage preference updates chip values, progress bars, tooltips, and an open provider popover; the setting synchronizes across windows and clamps invalid percentages.

records.upstreamTitle: Support async Codex agent questions
records.rationale: Adapt asynchronous agentMessage questions to Voktty's shared question queue and turn/steer response lifecycle, preserving cancellation and secret-input protections.

records.upstreamTitle: fix(codex): omit collaboration mode until a model is known (#771)
records.rationale: Omit model overrides until the provider model is selected while retaining Voktty's read-only plan sandbox and approval policy.

records.upstreamTitle: Run the same codex the user's shell does (#878)
records.rationale: Prefer the Codex executable found by the login shell and retain platform-specific installation fallbacks; keep the resolver in the native Harness host.

records.upstreamTitle: Preserve remote sessions when opening local projects
deferred: Remote tab matching and stale connection bindings in the connections Host surface; revisit with the Voktty-native SSH agent and tmux integration.
records.rationale: Do not reuse a restored remote:// session as a blank local conversation before its transcript arrives. This is a partial adaptation; the connections tab-binding behavior is deferred to the native SSH/tmux migration.

records.upstreamTitle: Improve rendering performance for large streamed Markdown fences (#863)
records.rationale: The streamed-fence optimization is already adapted across four focused Voktty commits: incremental Shiki checkpoints, memoized highlighted lines, fence-aware Markdown repair, and fence-preserving word fades. Existing focused tests cover each core behavior; the upstream opt-in browser timing fixture is not needed for functional parity.

records.upstreamTitle: fix: keep markdown table columns readable (#876)
records.rationale: Voktty already applies the same 10rem minimum width and top alignment to Harness Markdown table cells. This presentation-only CSS rule needs no additional test.

records.upstreamTitle: Drop a reorder drag whose pointerup never arrived (#879)
records.rationale: Voktty already cancels a mouse reorder when pointerup is missed, and additionally ignores pointer movement from another pointer. The focused sortable tests cover cancellation without applying a reorder.

records.upstreamTitle: Stop repeating a thought's first paragraph when its row is opened (#882)
records.rationale: Opening a thought row replaces its summary with Voktty's localized Thinking label, so the first paragraph appears only in the body. The local regression checks open and close behavior in English and Spanish.

records.upstreamTitle: Allow editing commit message without staged files
records.rationale: The commit-message editor remains writable when no files are staged, while the commit action still requires staged files and a non-empty message. The editor now disables during a Git action, matching the upstream busy-state guard.

records.upstreamTitle: Add slide and reveal animations to linked work item panel
records.rationale: The Voktty detail pane slides in and reveals each selected issue or pull request. Its reducer ignores stale animation completions after rapid selection changes, and the scoped styles honor reduced-motion preferences.

records.upstreamTitle: Add activity timeline to PR/issue panels with commit interleaving
deferred: Voktty prefetches GitHub issue and PR details when an Inbox card is hovered. MonoCode triggers prefetch from a linked-work-item action on session cards; Voktty has no matching session-card entry point, so the interaction remains adapted to Inbox.
records.rationale: The chronological comments and commits timeline, freshness-aware GitHub cache, PR overview, changed-file glance and focused diff behavior existed in Voktty before the audit baseline. GitHub issue and PR details now prefetch on Inbox card hover using the existing freshness cache. The trigger follows Voktty's Inbox workflow; MonoCode's linked-work-item action on session cards has no matching Voktty entry point, so coverage remains partial.

records.upstreamTitle: Prevent model picker labels from truncating
records.rationale: The selected Harness model label stays on one line and the trigger keeps its intrinsic width, so long model names are not clipped in the composer.

records.upstreamTitle: Add folder staging actions to Git changes panel
records.rationale: Folder actions derive an exact list of changed paths under the selected subtree and pass those paths through Voktty's existing authorized Git stage/unstage operations with WorkspaceEnv. Folder state and path boundaries have focused regression coverage; no directory-specific filesystem IPC or Host route is needed.

records.upstreamTitle: Preserve descenders in explorer file names (#678)
records.rationale: MonoCode adds a label line-height utility because its truncated tree label inherits leading-none. Voktty's equivalent TreeRow label does not inherit leading-none and fits within its 22px row using the normal inherited line-height, so the clipping condition is absent.

records.upstreamTitle: Animate pane entry from split edge
records.rationale: New Voktty panes enter from their split edge, with a fade for restored panes and reduced-motion support. The local PaneTree regression suite protects direction, lifecycle, and scroll restoration behavior.

records.upstreamTitle: Extract permissions to dedicated picker modal
records.rationale: The permissions selector is extracted into the dedicated picker modal in Voktty's quick composer. The existing model-selector test covers the picker behavior while Voktty keeps its own model catalog and permission policy.

records.upstreamTitle: Fix Changes list file selection click target and latency (#830)
records.rationale: Voktty opens source-control diffs through exact repo-root paths, avoiding a project-index scan and preserving ignored files. The change row's file button fills the row height. The existing file-index regression covers exact opens when the path is absent from the index.

records.upstreamTitle: Add effort selection animations for other harnesses (#672)
records.rationale: The max and ultra effort shimmer applies to Codex reasoning effort, OpenCode variants, Claude effort, and Cursor effort. Other settings and ordinary values remain unanimated; focused tests cover all four setting IDs and the non-effort case.

records.upstreamTitle: feat(opencode): support OpenCode 2.x servers (#434)
deferred: Route remote OpenCode 2.x service discovery and authenticated HTTP/SSE through Voktty's native SSH agent, with tmux recovery for Docker hosts; validate reconnect and cleanup before claiming remote parity.
records.rationale: Voktty already supports OpenCode 2.x on desktop: version gating, service authentication, the v2 catalog and agents, prompt and permission adaptation, event translation and correlation, compaction, resumed-session forks, and temporary text-session cleanup. Its service commands are scoped to OpenCode and authorized workspaces. The forced catalog refresh contract predated this port in Voktty's registry; the OpenCode settings action now calls it and a regression covers the bypass. Remote sessions still need the native SSH/tmux migration for Docker recovery.

records.upstreamTitle: Route ⌘W and ⌘T to the focused project terminal (#774)
records.rationale: Route ⌘/Ctrl+T and ⌘/Ctrl+W through the focused project dock only when the dock is open, its focus flag is set, and the active DOM element remains inside it. Keyboard focus is tracked by the dock, and a stale focus flag cannot redirect pane-close buttons. Voktty has no native app-menu command producer matching the upstream menu hunk; its existing new_tab/close_tab event bridge uses the same focus-aware routing.

records.upstreamTitle: Add `Back` to revisit earlier answers in the question panel (#688)
records.rationale: Add a localized Back action to the multi-question Harness form. Answers remain keyed by question id, so users can return, change an earlier choice, and submit the revised answers.

records.upstreamTitle: Add colorblind-friendly diff palettes and +/- line markers (#707)
records.rationale: Voktty adapts the global palette tokens, persisted colorblind/high-contrast choices, accessible line glyphs, and all matching diff summaries and previews across its Harness and source-control surfaces. The setting lives in Voktty's Harness tab and is searchable from global Settings, rather than MonoCode's appearance page and search index. Voktty's existing untracked status remains visually distinct from added lines. The upstream changelog has no local counterpart.

records.upstreamTitle: fix(files): open markdown diffs as source instead of preview (#660)
records.rationale: Voktty routes active review tabs through GitDiffPane, which already renders Markdown as source. FileEditor's optional diff mode now also uses an isolated review preference with source as its fallback, so normal file preview preferences remain independent.

records.upstreamTitle: Detect npm-installed Pi agent via package manifest (#687)
records.rationale: Voktty's native Rust Host first keeps the launcher marker scan, then resolves the executable symlink and checks the bounded enclosing npm package manifest for an exact supported Pi package name before trying a help probe. The native agent owns provider resolution, including for remote Harness execution.

records.upstreamTitle: Focus the model search once the flyout is on screen (#670)
records.rationale: The local ModelFlyout now focuses its search after the next animation frame, once Popover finishes measuring and revealing the anchored surface. The regression verifies focus stays put until that frame and moves to search afterward. Voktty has one ModelFlyout call site, so the focus behavior covers its model submenu path.

records.upstreamTitle: fix(pi): discover models registered by extensions (#645)
records.rationale: Pi catalog probes now load extensions so models registered by Pi extensions can be discovered. OMP probes retain --no-extensions. Catalog refresh is requested per provider, so the larger Pi extension load remains on demand; probes still use --no-session.

records.upstreamTitle: fix(gitlab): support merge request diffs on older instances (#723)
records.rationale: Merge request diff loading falls back to the older /changes endpoint only when /diffs returns HTTP 404. It preserves pagination/overflow truncation, keeps authentication and other HTTP failures visible, and uses the existing timeout and redirect-disabled GitLab client. Mock-server regressions cover the fallback, the modern endpoint, and non-404 errors; the Tauri command contract is unchanged.

records.upstreamTitle: Make the live activity ticker expandable
records.rationale: Voktty's session transcript shows active work inline and puts answered work behind its WorkFoldLine, which users can expand again. The Mono-specific header state from upstream has no local counterpart; the existing transcript fold supplies the activity access in Voktty's layout without a second control or state owner. This implementation and its fold tests were present before the pinned local baseline.

records.upstreamTitle: Release v0.10.0
records.rationale: The source change removes temporary scroll-debug instrumentation, which Voktty's transcript does not contain. The remaining changes are MonoCode 0.10.0 release notes and package/version metadata, which are specific to the upstream product and have no Harness behavior to port.

records.upstreamTitle: Add session changes panel for Mono diffs
records.rationale: MonoCode needs a separate side panel because its Mono view covers project tabs. Voktty's workspace already opens the exact session's checkpoint diff in a Session Changes file pane beside the chat, and reuses one tab per session while focusing the requested path. The session-aware panel, routing, and layout tests were in the pinned local baseline.

records.upstreamTitle: Add commit tab to Mono changes panel
records.rationale: Voktty adapts the commit tab to the native Git status list. Exact session files start selected; other project changes are opt-in, and shared session files stay blocked. Path-scoped commit, push/publish, and GitHub PR status and creation keep the active WorkspaceEnv for Voktty's native SSH and Docker transport. Commit messages use bounded selected-file context from native.gitDiff, while PR title and body use bounded branch-range context from native.gitCompareBranches and native.gitShowCommit. Both contexts go directly to the session's Harness without a second Git lookup; PR generation first checks that the native commit range matches GitHub's ahead count.

records.upstreamTitle: Treat Git paths literally when staging folders
records.rationale: The existing Host sidecar already treats folder arguments literally and has its regression test in 22c2707. Native Git stage/unstage and legacy Harness staging now pass --literal-pathspecs through local, SSH, Docker, and WSL Git execution. A stage/unstage-only path resolver permits colon-containing literal folder names while preserving traversal and repository-boundary checks; ordinary path validation remains strict.

records.upstreamTitle: Make diff stats resize to fit sidebar
records.rationale: Voktty shows project and session diff counts in both its Changes tab and session cards. The extracted DiffStat component scales its text to the measured space and watches the container so counts grow again after a sidebar resize. Existing localization and monospace styling remain in use; the session-card trailing row can shrink so long counts do not push out its label or Harness icon.

records.upstreamTitle: Keep IME composition intact in remote session composers (#741)
records.rationale: The composer keeps its mount-time textarea defaultValue while the existing effect applies later remote draft updates. This prevents polling-driven React renders from rewriting the text node during a WebKit IME composition; the regression preserves the in-progress value after a parent rerender.

records.upstreamTitle: fix(skills): raise the skill catalog cap from 300 to 5,000 (#750)
records.rationale: Voktty's native skill catalog now permits up to 5,000 unique skills across its ordered project, user, and provider roots. A regression creates 1,400 user skills and a Codex-only skill to ensure the larger personal root no longer hides later provider skills. Frontmatter reads remain bounded to 16 KiB per skill.

records.upstreamTitle: Harden Composer file drop handling
records.rationale: Voktty's Composer accepts DOM and native file drops, checks native coordinates with the platform-aware converter, retains the listener across Harness capability changes, discards stale reads, and waits for reads before Send. It reports empty native image paths and failed reads with localized generic guidance, without exposing filesystem paths.

records.upstreamTitle: Improve scroll stability and output reveal pacing
records.rationale: Voktty already applies the same behaviors across its native transcript design: it reconciles user movement with scroll events and layout clamping, observes turn-size changes in DOM order, leaves wheel gestures to nested scrollers, and preserves the composer viewport while resizing. Newly arrived replies are paced before their first paint; opening existing or hidden-tab output remains immediate.

records.upstreamTitle: Add searchable worktree creation to sidebar switcher
deferred: Expose search and creation in Voktty's sidebar switcher after replacing its unregistered git_worktrees and git_worktree_create calls with WorkspaceEnv-aware native APIs that cover local, WSL, SSH through Voktty's agent, and Docker workspaces.
records.rationale: Voktty already has a searchable worktree picker and a branch-creation dialog in its session UI, but its sidebar switcher only selects existing entries. The shared helper calls git_worktrees and git_worktree_create, neither of which is registered in Voktty's Tauri command handler. Existing git_list_branches and session-scoped git_worktree_add do not provide the generic list/create contract. Keep this row partial until the sidebar uses authorized native Git operations and the Voktty SSH agent for remote workspaces.

records.upstreamTitle: Move workspace actions into the sidebar header
records.rationale: Voktty places Go to File and New Session in the workspace sidebar header while the project rail is visible. When the rail is collapsed, that header is unavailable, so Voktty keeps the actions in TitleBar to preserve access. This adapts the action placement to Voktty's layout while keeping the same workspace actions reachable.

records.upstreamTitle: Add soft fades to clipped tabs and scroll areas
records.rationale: Voktty already fades overflowing tab labels and the bottom edge of long session lists and docked transcripts. The transcript content also has bottom padding so the final reply can scroll clear of the fade; the selector and class names follow Voktty's Harness structure.

records.upstreamTitle: Stop the remote folder dialog from darkening the window (#733)
records.rationale: The remote folder dialog now leaves the full-window backdrop clear, preventing light content behind its glass panel from turning grey. The backdrop still handles outside-click cancellation.

records.upstreamTitle: Open general new terminals in the active session's worktree (#732)
records.rationale: General Harness terminal actions prefer the active session's non-removed worktree, then the focused pane, session, and project directories. Session-scoped and standalone Harness terminals use the same worktree validity rule. Voktty's existing terminal creation path remains responsible for opening the terminal.

records.upstreamTitle: Fix editor diff gutter layout and Inbox PR overview diff colors (#759)
records.rationale: Voktty already positions the diff glyph lane after line numbers, shows original line numbers for removed rows, and tints changed gutter rows. The Inbox PR overview already uses the selected diff palette for counts and file bars. These adaptations are covered by local commits 3ee0e4d and 02af232; the gutter regression checks the lane order and row classes.

records.upstreamTitle: Optimize streaming output, file indexes, and transcript rendering
records.rationale: Voktty had already integrated this performance work across five local commits: foreground/background event batching, hidden explorer retention, worktree file-index caching and resume validation, transcript turn memoization, and pooled transcript updates. Voktty's cache retains its Zen/classic grouping and its transcript pool keeps pane focus handling in the owning module. Its performance regression suite covers the changed behaviors, including hidden prompt measurement.

records.upstreamTitle: Improve modal layering and light-theme styling
records.rationale: Voktty now explicitly layers each dialog backdrop below its panel. The remote-folder dialog keeps the clear backdrop required by its earlier fix while adding a light-theme base surface; Harness dialogs retain Voktty's theme-aware floating surface and existing title style. Regression tests cover the remote backdrop and panel surface, SwitchBranchDialog stacking, and shared Modal panel stacking.

records.upstreamTitle: Preserve transcript scroll position during asynchronous updates
records.rationale: Voktty already reconciles the browser's scroll offset before asynchronous stream commits and ResizeObserver updates, and resumes following only when the reader reaches the bottom. The same intent rule covers live activity phases. Local scroll tests cover delayed scroll events, async content growth, small downward reversals, and wheel gestures.

records.upstreamTitle: fix: preserve focused note title drafts (#769)
records.rationale: Focused note title drafts, including blank drafts, remain visible while body saves complete. Blur and unmount normalize and commit the draft, with all writes serialized to prevent an earlier save from overwriting the final title. Regression tests cover blank and replacement drafts, delayed body saves, and unmount.

records.upstreamTitle: Render Nerd Font prompt glyphs in the terminal (#767)
records.rationale: The terminal renderer uses Voktty's configurable font-family resolver, so the Nerd Font fallback stack is attached to that shared runtime setting rather than a new CSS variable. User-selected families stay first, followed by system monospace and explicit Nerd Font symbol families for shell prompt glyphs.

records.upstreamTitle: Keep Pi extension status in one row per key (#760)
records.rationale: Pi extension setStatus calls now carry their statusKey into the transcript. Harness updates one system row for that key during the current user turn, removes it on clear, and preserves independent keys and unkeyed notifications. Voktty's session sanitizer keeps the key across storage and restore so the live status can continue updating after a reload.

records.upstreamTitle: Hide internal and legacy Copilot models from Pi/omp catalogs (#766)
records.rationale: The OMP Copilot catalog includes internal agent endpoints and legacy snapshots that the provider picker omits. Filter only github-copilot model ids, preserving current Copilot choices and identically named models from other providers.

records.upstreamTitle: Throttle GitHub polling and handle rate-limit backoff
deferred: Voktty does not have MonoCode's PR Checks tab or its foreground checks polling. Revisit if that surface is added.
records.rationale: Voktty routes Harness GitHub CLI calls through one native gh_run path. A shared backoff pauses primary and secondary rate-limited requests, probes the GraphQL quota reset when appropriate, and falls back to a short pause if the probe fails. Inbox lists stay fresh for two minutes, detail data for thirty seconds, the badge refreshes every two minutes while visible and five minutes while hidden, and stale GitHub entries remain visible when refresh is rate limited. The Inbox card no longer prefetches linked GitHub details on hover. The Checks tab polling is deferred because Voktty has no corresponding tab.
